en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali Bin Atiyya, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The dawn, it is which, when you see it unobstructed, it is as if it is a white edge’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Ali ibn ‘ Atiyyah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Dawn is when you see it, widthwise, like the whiteness of the suray (canal) (Euphrates river).”’
